about: Models for the shared-read test, newest open weights on Ollama as of 2026-10-30, sized for a 36 GB Mac with one model loaded at a time. gb is roughly the memory once loaded (file size plus room for the context). Change models here, not in code, then run `scripts/shared_read.py freeze` before the first real run.

reader.note: Newest Qwen (Aug 2026); only size on Ollama is 27B, ~18 GB file at 4-bit. Thinks by default; 'none' asks it not to. Fallback if it won't fit or is too slow: gemma4:12b (~8 GB).

ants.note: Gemma 4, 2.3B effective; thinks only when asked.
Qwen 3.5 (Mar 2026), the newest small Qwen; same family as the reader on purpose, to see if a same-family ant gains more.
Liquid LFM3, 1.7B, a non-transformer hybrid: adds a different kind of mind to the swarm.
